name: PR brief renders from the stored brief and deep-links into the diff
description: PR #482 ships a stored brief (SEED_PR_482_BRIEF in server/src/db/seed-pulls.ts). The Overview must render its summary from GET /pulls/:id/brief with no model call (AC-47, AC-96), still render it after a fresh page load, and a Review-focus item (src/api/users.ts:45) must open Files changed via ?tab=diff&file=&line= (AC-31). The summary text below must stay in lock-step with the seed. No reload command: a fresh `open` is an equivalent new document load. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
